text:
Sam - People Ops: Quick company-wide note: were consolidating three caregiver-related policies into a single Caregiver Leave & Support policy effective today. This brings Parental Leave top-ups, Emergency Caregiver Leave, and Dependent Care Stipends under one roof. Full policy: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/caregiver-consolidation

Yara - People Ops: TL;DR: 1) One-stop policy page + single claim workflow in Workday; 2) Emergency Caregiver Leave (ECL) stays at 5 paid days per incident, but now theres a streamlined fast-claim for urgent cases; 3) Dependent Care Stipend consolidated to a single annual $1,200 allowance (previously split across programs).

Kofi: Does this change eligibility for ongoing parental top-ups?

Sam - People Ops: No change to eligibility. Parental top-ups remain as-is (pilot or permanent programs unchanged). We only unified administration and simplified the forms. Examples included in the doc show interactions with state benefits.

Maya: How will managers see these consolidated claims? Any UI changes in Workday?

Yara - People Ops: Workday will show a single "Caregiver Support" request type with sub-type dropdown (Parental Top-Up, ECL, Dependent Stipend). Managers still approve requests, but approvals route to People Ops automatically for stipend or top-up payments. We added an "Expedite" checkbox for urgent approvals.

Kofi: If someone already has a pending stipend request under old flow, what happens?

Sam - People Ops: Old pending requests are auto-migrated to the new flow overnight. No action needed. If you see anything odd, DM people-ops and well reconcile within 2 business days.

Maya: Any payroll/tax changes for the stipend consolidation?

Yara - People Ops: The $1,200 annual stipend is taxable and paid out in the payroll after approval. If you had multiple partial stipends in a year, well cap the total paid to $1,200. Payroll FAQ linked in the policy. HR-Bot uploaded the PDF and migration notes.

HR-Bot: Policy & migration notes: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/caregiver-consolidation.pdf. Workday form updated; help guide attached in the doc.

Sam - People Ops: Manager note: were running a short webinar (30m) Tues 8:00am PT to show the new workflow. RSVP in the policy doc. Also launching a short FAQ email to all managers today.

Kofi: Nice 44dOne request: can we add an example for international employees where statutory benefits differ? That confused my team before.

Yara - People Ops: Good call  we added an international appendix with examples and a contact path for cross-border cases. If you have a specific country to flag, reply here and well prioritize.

Maya: Thanks team 64fWill share with my org and book the webinar.
